player_prompt.intro:
Wakutana nacho kuicheza Countdown ya nambari!
Lengo: Changanua nambari kwa kutumia +, -, *, / ili kufikia ligawo.
Mtindo wa tchito: [i j op] ambapo i,j ndizo viwianishi na op ndiyo tchito.
Mfano: [0 2 *] inazidisha nambari kwenye viwianishi 0 na nambari kwenye viwianishi 2.
Mgawanyiko unapaswa kusababisha nambari nzima pekee.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Zindikirani zosagwira ntchito. Ziyenera kukhala zosiyana ndipo zili pakati pa 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Ntchito yolakwika (kugawa ndi zero kapena zotsatira zosakhala integer)

outcome.win: Cikaŵa cakwenelera kuti ŵakome munthu uyu. {target}
